expected_value_creation: Make candidate policy effects inspectable before authorization by deterministically replaying unchanged evidence and preserving hypothetical loss-boundary uncertainty.
beneficiary: QIF evaluators, accountable policy owners, affected stakeholders, and human/AI review organizations
supporting_evidence: v0.6.39 already preserves candidate revisions, exact changes, decisions, replay scope, and rollback boundaries.
Anthropic CHIVE evaluates explanations through counterfactual edits and measured outcomes while not treating explanations as ground truth.
OpenAI agent eval guidance recommends repeatable datasets and trace grading to compare prompt or routing changes.
success_criteria: Every counterfactual variant is reviewed, explicitly non-authoritative, and traceable to a baseline policy snapshot.
Every replay reuses the same evidence input and deterministically reproduces baseline and counterfactual rule and route outputs.
Every loss-boundary consequence is labeled hypothetical and routed to governance when severe, uncertain, unverified, or incomplete.
The verifier rejects optimization, ranking, automatic selection, automatic authorization, mutation, and semantic-truth claims.
